_comment: Advisories `npm run audit:deps` accepts for now. Each entry needs the GitHub advisory id, the package, a written reason, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); past that date the build fails again until the entry is fixed or renewed on purpose, in a pull request.

accepted.reason: No fixed version exists (2.0.1 is the latest). Reached only through puppeteer-core -> @puppeteer/browsers, which unzips a browser it downloads; this repo downloads none (Lighthouse drives the Chrome already on the machine), and the package is a dev dependency of the performance check, never in the shipped build (`npm audit --omit=dev` is clean).
Same package and same reasoning as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: no fix published, never unzips anything here, dev dependency only.
